Discovery, request, usage, qualification, public production projection, and run-manifest evidence bind exact output mode, capability hash, request shape, response hashes, validation status, and repair state.

The broad local output/qualification/pipeline matrix passed 1096 tests; Ruff, strict mypy over 137 source files, schema synchronization, and the complete suite passed with 2206 tests and 10 explicit prerequisite skips.
